notes: Myntra Home & Living (https://www.myntra.com/shop/home-living). Access: direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no WAF/bot-block, no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow. Checked: (1) Walked the full sitewide navigationData__ JSON (homepage + /shop/home-living SSR HTML) node-by-node under the 'Home' branch and sitewide - zero nodes titled/linked Clearance, Outlet, Final Sale, Last Chance, or End of Line anywhere. (2) Homepage footer - no sale/offer/clearance/outlet links found. The totalCount values themselves (in the millions, larger than Myntra's entire catalog segment for Home) are further proof these are unbounded keyword matches, not a real listing. (4) Per-PLP sort control on Home & Living categories (sampled /decorhome) includes a 'discount' sort option - this reorders the SAME category/product set by discount percentage under the SAME URL and totalCount; it is not a distinct clearance/outlet listing with its own product set, so excluded per the Sale-vs-Clearance test (no permanence signal, no distinct taxonomy, just a sort of the existing category). No ambiguous Sale-worded page with a plausible permanent-markdown signal was found to flag for manual review either - the only 'sale'-shaped surface (sort=discount) is clearly a temporary reordering mechanism, not a clearance concept. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance-type PLP exists for Myntra Home & Living (or sitewide) as of this pass.
